description: Return the share link settings for a Lite server (by id or exact name): the share URL friends can use to start the server, whether it is locked, whether a password is required, any Discord invite shown on the share page, and (only when `confirm` is true) the password. Works while the server is hibernating too, since these settings persist while it sleeps. Only Lite servers have a share link.

confirm.description: Set true to include the share password in plaintext. Only do this when the user explicitly asked to see it.

instance.description: Instance id (preferred) or exact instance name.

name: get_jit_share
title: Get Share Link Settings
